Charlotte Perkins Gilman, Moving the Mountain.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/charlotte-perkins-gilman/moving-the-mountain

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Charlotte Perkins Gilman, the author, died 1935.

First publication of the text used: 1911 (SE colophon: 'Moving the Mountain was published in 1911 by Charlotte Perkins Gilman.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1911, before 1931; a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 2006.
- Country of origin (United States, where the text was first published): the United States rule above also settles the country of origin, so no other country's term applies.
